intro: Barbecue is priced per order and grilled at your table. Every order comes with banchan, lettuce wraps, ssamjang and steamed rice.
notes: Consuming raw or undercooked meats, poultry, seafood, shellfish or eggs may increase your risk of foodborne illness.
Please tell your server about any allergies. Many dishes contain soy, sesame, wheat, shellfish or fish sauce.
This is a sample menu for a fictional restaurant. Items and prices are illustrative.
